response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
), station_avgs AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT sa.observstation,
       sa.avg_bandusagepct,
       sa.avg_bandusagepct - oa.avg_bandusagepct AS above_overall_avg
FROM station_avgs AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa
WHERE sa.avg_bandusagepct > oa.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Stations without any telescope rows are excluded; AVG ignores NULL bandwidth values, and the overall average weights each non-NULL telescope value equally.
